id: 09_Radiography Safety Officer (RSO) Interview Questions and Answers
title: 射线探伤安全员面试问答
source_doc: course/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/09_Radiography Safety Officer (RSO) Interview Questions and Answers.md
author_source: project/ACS Hazard Communication & Safety/09_Radiography Safety Officer (RSO) Interview Questions and Answers/src.py

points.K5: 放射工作人员一年可接受的剂量
points.K7: 探伤作业前安全员要核查
points.K10: 探伤人员和公众的安全剂量率

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽，站在一段管道旁招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot in a hard hat stands beside a section of steel pipeline and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 今天的面试题：工业射线探伤！
overlay: 射线探伤安全员面试问答

shots.scene: 辐射警告标志旁十二个小方格
shots.prompt_en: A radiation warning sign next to twelve small squares in a grid. No people.
shots.narration: 一共十二道题。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着空白简历，站在管道工地边
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank resume at the edge of a pipeline construction site.
shots.narration: 阿杰要应聘射线探伤安全员。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一个巡测仪图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a simple survey meter icon.
shots.narration: 这些题，我们一道道过。

shots.scene: 探伤设备架在管道焊口上
shots.prompt_en: A plain radiography device is clamped onto a pipe weld joint. No people.
shots.narration: 射线探伤：对管道做无损检测。

shots.scene: 管道剖面上显出裂纹、气孔、针孔
shots.prompt_en: A pipe cross section reveals icons of a crack, porosity bubbles and a pinhole. No people.
shots.narration: 不切不损，就能发现裂纹、气孔、针孔。

shots.scene: 伽马探伤机和X射线探伤机两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two device icons: a gamma radiography camera and an X-ray radiography unit. No people.
shots.narration: 用伽马或X射线探伤机，保证质量。

shots.scene: 旧管道和焊口图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an old pipe section and a welded joint. No people.
shots.narration: 一般用于旧管道和焊接接头。

shots.scene: 三张单位卡片
shots.prompt_en: Three blank unit cards in a row with a radiation trefoil above them. No people.
shots.narration: 辐射单位：居里、微希沃特、毫雷姆。

shots.scene: 老李手持巡测仪测量
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds a handheld survey meter near a pipeline work area.
shots.narration: 盖革计数器：测量辐射水平的仪器。

shots.scene: 地面画出距离线
shots.prompt_en: A distance line drawn on the ground away from the device, with a survey meter icon. No people.
shots.narration: 也用来确定安全距离。

shots.scene: 胸前别着个人剂量计的小人图标
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram with a small personal dosimeter clipped to the chest. No people.
shots.narration: 个人剂量计：测探伤人员受到的剂量。

shots.section_title: 放射工作人员一年可接受的剂量
shots.scene: 日历一年，旁边一个数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A one-year calendar next to a large blank number card. No people.
shots.narration: 探伤人员一年的安全剂量是多少？
overlay: 放射工作人员一年可接受的剂量

shots.section_title: 放射工作人员一年可接受的剂量
shots.scene: 数字牌亮起
shots.prompt_en: The number card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 原片答案：每年20毫希沃特。

shots.scene: 小人图标长时间站在辐射标志旁
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram stands next to a radiation trefoil while a clock spins. No people.
shots.narration: 危害：长期受到照射。

shots.scene: 脱发和癌症图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of hair falling out and a cell with a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 会脱发、致癌。

shots.scene: 皮肤灼伤和骷髅图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a skin burn and a skull pictogram. No people.
shots.narration: 大剂量会灼伤皮肤，甚至致死。

shots.scene: 闲人走进警戒区、无证人员操作，都被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a person walking into a cordoned zone and a person without a badge operating a device. No people.
shots.narration: 还有闲人闯入、无资质人员作业。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前安全员要核查
shots.scene: 王老师拿着空白许可证和评估表
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator holds a blank work permit and a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 作业前核查：作业许可、JSA或风险评估。
overlay: 探伤作业前安全员要核查

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前安全员要核查
shots.scene: 放射源许可证和校准证书图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank source license card and two blank calibration certificates for a meter and a dosimeter. No people.
shots.narration: 放射源有效许可，仪表校准证书。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前安全员要核查
shots.scene: 资质证书和体检报告图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a blank qualification certificate and a blank medical report with an eye chart. No people.
shots.narration: 探伤人员第三方资质，体检视力报告。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前安全员要核查
shots.scene: 欣欣指着资质证书
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the qualification certificate.
shots.narration: 资质由国外辐射防护机构认可。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前安全员要核查
shots.scene: 衰变表和运输车辆图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a decay chart and a transport van with a blank certificate. No people.
shots.narration: 衰变表，核监管批准的运输车辆证明。

shots.section_title: 探伤作业前安全员要核查
shots.scene: 作业区拉起隔离带，挂辐射警告标志和警示灯
shots.prompt_en: A work area cordoned off with barrier tape, a radiation warning sign and flashing warning lights. No people.
shots.narration: 作业区设隔离、警示标志和警示灯。

shots.scene: 一条随时间下降的曲线
shots.prompt_en: A curve going down over time on a simple chart with a calendar icon. No people.
shots.narration: 衰变表：放射性随时间变化的图表。

shots.scene: 隔离带内的区域，探伤人员图标在里面
shots.prompt_en: An area inside barrier tape with a worker pictogram with a dosimeter working inside. No people.
shots.narration: 控制区：探伤人员可以工作的区域。

shots.section_title: 探伤人员和公众的安全剂量率
shots.scene: 探伤人员图标旁一个数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A worker pictogram with a dosimeter next to a blank number card and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 探伤人员安全剂量率：每小时7.5微希。
overlay: 探伤人员和公众的安全剂量率

shots.section_title: 探伤人员和公众的安全剂量率
shots.scene: 路人图标旁一个数字牌
shots.prompt_en: A passer-by pictogram next to a smaller blank number card and a clock. No people.
shots.narration: 公众的安全限值：每小时2.5微希。

shots.scene: 紫色胶片剂量计盒别在衣服上
shots.prompt_en: A small purple film badge clipped to a work shirt pocket. No people.
shots.narration: 胶片剂量计：佩戴式剂量计。

shots.scene: 日历翻过一个月
shots.prompt_en: A calendar flips through one month next to the film badge. No people.
shots.narration: 测量一个月内受到的辐射剂量。

shots.scene: 三个原子模型，核内粒子数不同
shots.prompt_en: Three simple atom models of the same element with different numbers of particles in the nucleus. No people.
shots.narration: 同位素：原子序数同，质量数不同。

shots.scene: 一个原子稳定发绿光，一个不稳定向外放射
shots.prompt_en: One atom glows steady green while another unstable atom gives off radiating waves. No people.
shots.narration: 可能稳定，也可能不稳定。

shots.scene: 放射波穿过细胞图标，细胞出现警示
shots.prompt_en: Radiating waves pass through a cell icon, which shows a warning mark. No people.
shots.narration: 不稳定的会放出辐射，损伤组织致癌。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现管道和探伤机图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a pipe and a radiography device.
shots.narration: 射线探伤，是管道的无损检测。

shots.scene: 巡测仪、剂量计、胶片盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a survey meter, a dosimeter and a film badge. No people.
shots.narration: 巡测仪测水平，剂量计测个人剂量。

shots.scene: 三张数字牌
shots.prompt_en: Three blank number cards side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 原片数值：20毫希、7.5和2.5微希。

shots.scene: 证书、衰变表、隔离带图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of certificates, a decay chart and barrier tape. No people.
shots.narration: 作业前九项核查，现场隔离警示。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰在管道旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot and the young male student wave goodbye beside the pipeline.
shots.narration: 祝你面试成功，下期见！
